(i) a system with a monocular camera plus a single accelerometer is fully observable; and (ii) a system with two accelerometers plus a monocular camera is partially observable.

(a) the visual inertial system is observable with 1 or 3 inertial sensors; (b) the observability properties are not modified when removing 1 accelerometer; (c) the observability is reduced by removing 2 inertial sensors, unless the camera is extrinsicly calibrated; (d) the observability analysis of a nonlinear system can be performed when part of its controls are unknown.
the observability of the system does not change if the 3 gyro sensors are removed, and it does change only when both accelerometers are removed.
